import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    ans = 0
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
